The leadership reshuffle includes the appointment of new heads for key functions, such as corporate development, financial crime policy, and the strategic growth of Singapore as a leading international financial centre. These updates are designed to strengthen the organization's core operations and future oversight.
content_ta: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) தனது மூத்த மேலாண்மை குழுவில் மாற்றங்களை அறிவித்துள்ளது. நவம்பர் 1 முதல் நடைமுறைக்கு வரும் இந்த மாற்றங்களின் மூலம், கார்ப்பரேட் மேம்பாடு, நிதி குற்றவியல் கொள்கை மற்றும் சர்வதேச நிதி மையமாக சிங்கப்பூரை மேம்படுத்துதல் போன்ற முக்கிய துறைகளுக்கு புதிய தலைவர்கள் நியமிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளனர்.

title: Atlanta-Based Georgia Banking Company Files for Nasdaq Direct Listing
summary: Georgia Banking Company, an Atlanta-based bank holding company, filed with U.S. regulators to list its shares directly on the Nasdaq Capital Market, according to a registration statement filed on Friday. The company said existing shareholders are seeking to register the resale of up to 7.04... Read More
content: Georgia Banking Company, an Atlanta-based bank holding company, has officially filed with United States regulators to list its shares directly on the Nasdaq Capital Market. According to a registration statement filed on Friday, the move allows existing shareholders to register the resale of a significant portion of shares as the company pursues a direct public listing.
content_ta: Atlanta-வை தலைமையிடமாகக் கொண்டு செயல்படும் வங்கி ஹோல்டிங் நிறுவனமான Georgia Banking Company, தனது பங்குகளை Nasdaq Capital Market-ல் நேரடியாகப் பட்டியலிட அமெரிக்க ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரிகளிடம் முறையான பதிவு விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்துள்ளது. வெள்ளிக்கிழமை தாக்கல் செய்யப்பட்ட ஆவணங்களின்படி, இந்நிறுவனத்தின் தற்போதைய பங்குதாரர்கள் தங்கள் பங்குகளை மறுவிற்பனை செய்வதற்கான பதிவை மேற்கொள்ள இந்த நடவடிக்கை வழிவகை செய்கிறது.

title: Joint venture of OKX and NYSE parent ICE files for 24/7 tokenized U.S. stock trading
summary: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.
content: A joint venture involving OKX and NYSE parent ICE has filed an application to launch 24/7 tokenized U.S. stock trading. The new trading platform aims to offer tokenized shares for more than 60 U.S.-listed companies, operating under the SEC's recently introduced innovation exemption.
content_ta: OKX மற்றும் NYSE-ன் தாய் நிறுவனமான ICE இணைந்து, 24 மணி நேரமும் செயல்படும் tokenized U.S. stock trading தொடங்குவதற்காக விண்ணப்பித்துள்ளன. SEC-ன் புதிய innovation exemption-ன் கீழ், 60-க்கும் மேற்பட்ட U.S.-listed நிறுவனங்களின் tokenized shares-ஐ வழங்குவதை இந்த புதிய வர்த்தக தளம் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Ether's bitcoin-beating Q3 rally came with a catch. Liquidity thinned.
summary: Ether beat bitcoin in the third quarter, but its market liquidity got thinner, according to Coingecko.
content: Ether outperformed bitcoin during the third quarter in a notable rally, data shows. However, according to reports from CoinGecko, this market performance came with a catch as overall liquidity thinned significantly during the period.
content_ta: மூன்றாம் காலாண்டில் bitcoin-ஐ விட Ether சிறந்த வளர்ச்சியைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளதாகத் தரவுகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன. இருப்பினும், CoinGecko அறிக்கைகளின்படி, இந்த சந்தை உயர்வின் போது ஒட்டுமொத்த சந்தை நீர்மைத்தன்மை (liquidity) கணிசமாகக் குறைந்துள்ளதாகத் தெரியவந்துள்ளது.

title: Safe investor asks Swiss watchdog to intervene in governance dispute
summary: Greenfield Capital said it sought changes to Safe Ecosystem Foundation’s board for months before turning to the Swiss regulator.
content: Investment firm Greenfield Capital has asked Swiss regulators to intervene in a governance dispute involving the Safe Ecosystem Foundation. The investor stated it spent months trying to secure changes to the foundation's board before escalating the issue to the regulatory authority in Switzerland.
content_ta: Safe Ecosystem Foundation-னில் நிலவும் நிர்வாகப் பிரச்சனை குறித்து தலையிடுமாறு சுவிட்சர்லாந்து ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரியிடம் முதலீட்டு நிறுவனமான Greenfield Capital கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளது. ஃபவுண்டேஷனின் போர்ட்டில் மாற்றங்களைச் செய்ய பல மாதங்களாக முயற்சித்ததாகவும், அதன் பின்னரே சுவிட்சர்லாந்து அதிகாரிகளிடம் புகார் அளிக்கப்பட்டதாகவும் முதலீட்டாளர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

title: XRP and SOL ETF Demand Craters as Weekly Inflows Drop 94%+
summary: The past week was entirely different than the previous one.
content: Demand for XRP and SOL exchange-traded funds experienced a significant downturn recently. Weekly crypto inflows plummeted by over 94 percent, marking a dramatic shift compared to the strong momentum seen in the previous week. This steep decline highlights rapidly changing investor sentiment within the digital asset market for these specific products.
content_ta: சமீபத்தில் XRP மற்றும் SOL ETF-களுக்கான தேவை கடுமையாகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. வாராந்திர முதலீடுகள் 94 சதவீதத்திற்கும் அதிகமாக வீழ்ச்சியடைந்துள்ளன. கடந்த வாரத்துடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது இது ஒரு பெரிய மாற்றத்தைக் குறிக்கிறது. இந்த வீழ்ச்சியானது டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தையில் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் மனநிலையில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள விரைவான மாற்றத்தைக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Pump.fun volume hits $40M, beats Hyperliquid in revenue – Whales boost PUMP
summary: Pump.fun’s revenue momentum is gaining support from rising trading activity and fresh whale accumulation, strengthening the case for sustained growth.
content: Pump.fun has achieved $40 million in trading volume, successfully surpassing Hyperliquid in revenue. This strong financial momentum is being driven by rising trading activity and fresh accumulation by whales, highlighting growing market confidence and strengthening the platform's outlook for sustained growth in the competitive decentralized finance sector.
content_ta: Pump.fun அதன் வர்த்தக அளவில் $40 மில்லியனை எட்டியுள்ளது, மேலும் வருவாயில் Hyperliquid-ஐ வெற்றிகரமாக விஞ்சியுள்ளது. இந்த வலுவான நிதி வேகம், அதிகரித்து வரும் வர்த்தகச் செயல்பாடு மற்றும் பெரிய முதலீட்டாளர்களின் புதிய குவிப்பு ஆகியவற்றால் இயக்கப்படுகிறது, இது வளர்ந்து வரும் சந்தை நம்பிக்கையை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: Sonic’s rally has a money flow problem – THIS level decides what’s next for S
summary: Indicator analysis shows that a rally is possible, but significant risks remain.
content: Recent indicator analysis on Sonic reveals that while a price rally remains possible, the asset is currently facing a notable money flow problem. Technical chart levels will be crucial in determining the cryptocurrency's upcoming price trajectory and whether bullish momentum can be sustained amid underlying market risks.
content_ta: Sonic குறித்த சமீபத்திய தொழில்நுட்ப குறிகாட்டிகளின் பகுப்பாய்வு, விலை உயர்வு சாத்தியம் என்றாலும், தற்போது குறிப்பிடத்தக்க பணப் பாய்வுப் பிரச்சினையை எதிர்கொள்வதாகக் காட்டுகிறது. சந்தை அபாயங்களுக்கு மத்தியில் காளை சந்தை வேகத்தைத் தக்கவைக்க முடியுமா மற்றும் கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் அடுத்த கட்ட விலை நகர்வை நிர்ணயிப்பதில் குறிப்பிட்ட விலை நிலைகள் முக்கியமானதாக இருக்கும்.

title: Bitcoin Faces Make-or-Break Resistance at $87,200
summary: Bitcoin bulls are once again closing in on the crucial $87,200 resistance zone, a level that has repeatedly rejected the cryptocurrency in recent weeks.
content: Bitcoin bulls are once again closing in on the crucial $87,200 resistance zone. This price level has repeatedly rejected the cryptocurrency in recent weeks, making it a critical barrier for traders. Market participants are closely watching price action to see if momentum can finally break through this persistent ceiling.
content_ta: Bitcoin வாங்குவோர் மீண்டும் ஒருமுறை முக்கியமான $87,200 எதிர்ப்பு மண்டலத்தை நெருங்கி வருகின்றனர். சமீப வாரங்களில் இந்த விலை நிலை பலமுறை கிரிப்டோகரன்சியை பின்னுக்குத் தள்ளியுள்ளது, இது வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு ஒரு முக்கியமான தடையாக உள்ளது. இந்த தொடர்ச்சியான எல்லையை ஊடுருவி செல்ல இயலுமா என்பதை சந்தை பங்கேற்பாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாக கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Who Gets the 750,000 New AI Jobs? Mark Cuban Has a Warning
summary:
Employers have cited artificial intelligence (AI) in more than twice as many US job cuts this year as in all of 2025. Billionaire investor Mark Cuban, however, says workers are watching the wrong threat. Cuban’s argument shifts the focus from the technology to the people using it. New hiring data and a Gallup survey suggest
The post Who Gets the 750,000 New AI Jobs? Mark Cuban Has a Warning appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Employers in the United States have cited artificial intelligence in numerous job cuts this year, far exceeding past figures. However, billionaire investor Mark Cuban warns that workers are focusing on the wrong threat, shifting the attention from the technology itself to the people using it. New hiring data and a Gallup survey provide further insights into the changing landscape of AI employment.
content_ta: United States-ல் உள்ள Employers இந்த ஆண்டு வேலை குறைப்புக்களுக்கு artificial intelligence காரணத்தைக் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளனர். இருப்பினும், billionaire investor Mark Cuban, பணியாளர்கள் தவறான அச்சுறுத்தலைக் கவனிக்கிறார்கள் என்றும், கவனம் தொழில்நுட்பத்திலிருந்து அதைப் பயன்படுத்துபவர்கள் மீது திரும்ப வேண்டும் என்றும் எச்சரிக்கிறார். புதிய hiring data மற்றும் Gallup survey ஆகியவை AI வேலைவாய்ப்பின் மாறுபட்ட நிலவரம் குறித்து மேலும் பல தகவல்களை வழங்குகின்றன.

title: 8.5% Growth vs. 3.4% Interest: The Math Keeping the US Debt Spiral at Bay
summary:
The US debt spiral is not imminent as 8.5% growth outpaces the 3.4% average rate on federal debt despite 5% yields.
The post 8.5% Growth vs. 3.4% Interest: The Math Keeping the US Debt Spiral at Bay appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Despite rising yields touching 5 percent, fears of an imminent US debt spiral are being kept at bay. Current economic data shows that the United States is maintaining an 8.5 percent growth rate, which significantly outpaces the 3.4 percent average interest rate on federal debt, keeping the financial outlook stable for now.
content_ta: 5 சதவீதம் வரை வட்டி விகிதங்கள் உயர்ந்தாலும், உடனடி US கடன் நெருக்கடி பற்றிய அச்சம் தணிந்துள்ளது. தற்போதைய பொருளாதார தரவுகளின்படி, கூட்டாட்சி கடனுக்கான சராசரி வட்டி விகிதமான 3.4 சதவீதத்தை விட United States-இன் 8.5 சதவீத வளர்ச்சி விகிதம் அதிகமாக உள்ளது, இது இப்போதைக்கு நிதி நிலையை ஸ்திரமாக வைத்திருக்கிறது.

title: Schwab Strategist Warns a Single Mega-Cap Capex Miss Could Disrupt the AI-Driven Market
summary:
Schwab's Kevin Gordon says one mega-cap capex miss could disrupt S&P 500 earnings, as AI stocks carry a narrow market.
The post Schwab Strategist Warns a Single Mega-Cap Capex Miss Could Disrupt the AI-Driven Market appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Schwab strategist Kevin Gordon warns that a single capital expenditure miss by a mega-cap company could significantly disrupt the current AI-driven stock market. Because the S&P 500 earnings rely heavily on a narrow group of artificial intelligence leaders, any unexpected shortfall in spending could trigger broader market instability.
content_ta: Schwab-இன் strategist Kevin Gordon, ஒரு mega-cap நிறுவனத்தின் capex தவறுவது தற்போது AI-ஐ அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு இயங்கும் stock market-ஐ கடுமையாக பாதிக்கலாம் என்று எச்சரித்துள்ளார். S&P 500 earnings ஒரு சில artificial intelligence தலைவர்களை மட்டுமே சார்ந்துள்ளதால், செலவினங்களில் ஏற்படும் எதிர்பாராத சரிவு பரந்த அளவிலான சந்தை ஸ்திரமின்மையை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: Crypto bears get squeezed as $113 million in shorts liquidated in 24 hours
summary:
The liquidation of crypto shorts highlights the volatility and risks in leveraged trading, potentially leading to further market instability.
The post Crypto bears get squeezed as $113 million in shorts liquidated in 24 hours appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cryptocurrency markets experienced significant volatility recently as millions of dollars in short positions were liquidated within a 24-hour period. This sudden market movement put heavy pressure on bearish traders, highlighting the ongoing risks and rapid price swings associated with leveraged trading in the digital asset sector.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சந்தையில் சமீபத்தில் பெரும் விலை ஏற்றத்தாழ்வு ஏற்பட்டது. இதன் காரணமாக 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் மில்லியன் கணக்கான ட மதிப்புள்ள ஷார்ட் பொசிஷன்கள் லிக்யூட்டேட் செய்யப்பட்டன. இந்த திடீர் சந்தை மாற்றம் பேரிஷ் வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு கடுமையான அழுத்தத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியது, மேலும் இது டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துத் துறையில் லெவரெட்ஜ் வர்த்தகத்துடன் தொடர்புடைய ஆபத்துகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Payward partners with Singapore Gulf Bank for 24/7 settlement services

title: Euro hits 17-month low amid Spain election uncertainty
summary:
Political instability in Spain could exacerbate eurozone fiscal challenges, influencing investor confidence and impacting the euro's stability.
The post Euro hits 17-month low amid Spain election uncertainty appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The euro recently dropped to a 17-month low following political uncertainty surrounding elections in Spain. This instability raises concerns about potential fiscal challenges across the eurozone. Such political developments can heavily influence investor confidence and directly impact the overall stability of the euro in global markets.

title: AI Arms Race Is Radically Reshaping the Fraud Threat in EMEA, FICO Research Finds
summary:
New research from FICO, a leading global analytics software firm, shows that fraud leaders across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) are grappling with rising fraud complexity and AI-enabled threats, even as they accelerate investment in AI-driven detection and enterprise-wide fraud strategy. The findings, drawn from FICO's global survey of 202 senior fraud, risk and technology professionals at retail banks, neobanks and fintechs, show that 52% of EMEA institutions now cite increasing fraud complexity as their leading fraud prevention challenge, compared with just 40% of global firms. And nearly half ranked effective AI integration as a top challenge, underscoring that embedding AI into existing fraud controls remains as much an operational hurdle as a technological one.
“Fraud in EMEA is not accelerating out of control, but it is becoming far more sophisticated, and that shift matters just as much,” said Adam Davies, vice president, Product Management at FICO. “Fraudsters now have access to the same generative and agentic AI tools that banks are deploying to stop them, and they are using them to scale social engineering, synthetic identities and deepfake-enabled attacks. The institutions pulling ahead are the ones connecting their fraud functions across the enterprise and orchestrating every intelligence source they have, rather than adding point solutions one at a time.”
Other highlights from the FICO research for EMEA:
EMEA respondents rate AI-enhanced fraud (4.42 out of 5) and social engineering scams (4.36) as more significant threats than the global average (3.86 and 3.90 respectively), with synthetic identities (4.02) and deepfake fraud (3.96) also outpacing global concern levels
86% of EMEA institutions see a unified, enterprise-wide fraud strategy as essential, with 38% already treating it as a critical priority and 48% pursuing it as a longer-term focus
Half (51%) of EMEA institutions report false positive rates above 15%, creating friction for legitimate customers even as fraud controls tighten
Third-party vendor models now carry the greatest influence over EMEA fraud decisions (46%), far more than in-house models (24%), reflecting growing reliance on external expertise to keep pace with evolving threats
“The next 24 months will be defined by orchestration, not by any single piece of technology,” Davies added. “EMEA institutions have already built strong foundations in AI-driven detection, and confidence in agentic AI is particularly high in the region. What’s needed now is the connective tissue: bringing in-house models, vendor intelligence and consortium data together so fraud teams can act on a complete picture in real time, without pushing more friction onto legitimate customers.”
Davies points out four priorities for financial institutions in their fight against fraud:
Close the deployment gap by moving AI from pilot to production at enterprise scale. “You should prioritize what works within disciplined fraud control frameworks rather than launching yet more pilots,” he noted.  
Invest in active orchestration across models, channels, products, and portfolios so that shared signals shape fraud management decisions in real time.  
Apply risk-based, outcome-driven prioritization to balance competing investment demands, led by financial impact and regulatory exposure.  
Treat fraud prevention and customer experience as a single, connected challenge. “The organizations that can do both will be the ones that define competitive advantage in this era,” Davies said. 
FICO® Enterprise Fraud Solution, powered by FICO® Platform, addresses the full spectrum of fraud, from synthetic identity and application fraud to real-time payment scams and account takeover. Its composable, API-first architecture integrates with existing systems without requiring a rip-and-replace, while AI and ML models trained on billions of tagged transactions from a consortium of more than 10,000 financial institutions help drive detection accuracy while reducing false positives. Generative and agentic AI capabilities further accelerate investigation and decision-making, and digital simulation tools allow fraud teams to test and tune strategies before deployment.

title: Nearly Half of Asia Pacific Consumers Open to Using Stablecoins in the Next Five Years, Visa Study Finds
summary:
Visa, a world leader in digital payments, today released new survey findings on stablecoin awareness and consumer sentiment in Asia Pacific. The research reveals growing interest in practical uses such as everyday spending, travel and cross-border money movement, while limited understanding and concerns around trust remain barriers to wider use.
As stablecoins move beyond their crypto-native roots, consumers are beginning to view them less as a crypto-trading instrument and more as a potential tool for everyday spending, travel and cross-border transfers. Yet misconceptions remain widespread, with close to half believing stablecoins can only be used to buy or sell other cryptocurrencies. Turning this interest into everyday utility will depend on making stablecoins easier to understand and use through trusted, familiar and regulated payment experiences.
"We’re seeing a meaningful shift in how consumers across Asia Pacific think about stablecoins," said Nischint Sanghavi, Head of Digital Currencies, Asia Pacific at Visa. “Consumers are beginning to see how stablecoins could support the ways they already spend and move money, particularly through online purchases, travel and cross-border transfers. The opportunity now is to turn that interest into trusted and familiar payment experiences that work at scale.”
Consumers show rising interest in everyday stablecoin use
Across Asia Pacific, 46% of consumers say they are likely to use stablecoins within the next five years, compared with 16% who have used them in the past 12 months. Interest extends to everyday online purchases, travel spending and overseas shopping, pointing to potential use beyond investment or crypto trading. Cross-border money movement is another area of potential, with 49% believing stablecoins could become a common way to move money across borders within five years.
This points to possible relevance for remittances, international transfers and other payment needs. Yet understanding has not caught up with these emerging use cases: 49% of consumers who are aware of stablecoins still believe they can only be used to buy and sell other cryptocurrencies.
Market-level findings show where stablecoin awareness and intent are strongest across Asia Pacific. Hong Kong (84%), India (80%) and Thailand (77%) recorded the highest awareness, while Vietnam (67%) and India (67%) showed the strongest intent to use stablecoins within the next five years. These findings highlight the importance of making stablecoins available through secure payment experiences consumers already recognise and trust. Visa is already working with banks, regulated financial institutions and payment partners to connect stablecoin capabilities with familiar ways to pay and move money.
Stablecoin awareness is mainstream, but trust and understanding remain barriers
Stablecoins have entered mainstream awareness across Asia Pacific, with 66% of consumers aware of them. Yet only 6% demonstrate an accurate understanding of how stablecoins work, while misconceptions remain with 41% believing that stablecoins always increase in value.
Trust is also holding consumers back. Among those who are aware of stablecoins but have never used them, 38% cite concerns about fraud or scams, while 36% point to a lack of understanding. Consumers show the strongest preference for regulated institutions, with government or central bank-linked entities (27%) and banks or regulated financial institutions (26%) ranking as the most trusted providers.
While interest is growing, adoption will depend less on awareness alone and more on whether stablecoins can be made understandable, secure and useful in everyday payment contexts. The findings underscore the need for trusted and familiar ways to access stablecoins. Visa is working with banks, regulated financial institutions and payment partners to bring greater security, compliance and usability to stablecoin-enabled experiences, including through the Visa Stablecoin Platform, which helps clients mint, move and manage stablecoins.
“This research confirms what we’ve been building toward,” added Nischint. “Consumers want stablecoins to feel like a natural part of the payments they already trust, not a separate system. Our role is to connect emerging stablecoin technology with the secure, familiar payment experiences consumers rely on every day.”

title: Payments Canada Welcomes Six New Members
summary:
Payments Canada announced today the approval of six new members: Bounce Finance Inc. (“Bounce Pay”), Everlink Payment Services ULC (“FIS Everlink”), Nium Canada Corporation (“Nium”), Pesapeer Incorporated (“Pesa”), Remitly Canada, Inc. (“Remitly”) and Vancouver City Savings Credit Union (“Vancity").
This milestone coincides with the first anniversary of expanded Payments Canada membership eligibility—a strategic shift driven by two converging legislative developments that took effect in September 2025: historic amendments to the Canadian Payments Act to expand membership eligibility and implementation of the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA). Combined, these developments have enabled continued membership growth and momentum.
By expanding membership to payment service providers (PSPs) registered under the RPAA, local credit unions that are members of a central, and clearing houses of systems designated under the Payment Clearing and Settlement Act, a broader range of organizations are eligible to become members of Payments Canada and may choose to apply to participate directly in our payment systems. These are Lynx (Canada’s high-value payment system), the Automated Clearing Settlement System (ACSS, Canada’s retail batch payment system) and the Real-Time Rail (RTR), Canada's forthcoming real-time payment system.
Ensuring the safety and soundness of Canada’s payment systems remains a foundational priority for Payments Canada. Connecting to our systems requires meeting rigorous technical, operational and security standards tailored to each chosen participation model. These safeguards ensure that as our membership grows, the safety and resilience of Canada's national payment infrastructure are continuously protected.
“Modernizing Canada’s payment ecosystem is an important part of building a stronger, more competitive economy," said the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue. “The expansion of Payments Canada’s membership framework is creating new opportunities for innovation and competition while maintaining the safe and secure payment systems Canadians rely on. As more organizations prepare to participate in the Real-Time Rail, Canadians and businesses will benefit from faster, more efficient payment services.”
“Welcoming 22 members in our first year under the expanded eligibility framework demonstrates the industry’s strong desire to modernize payments and build upon Canada’s national critical payment infrastructure,” said Donna Kinoshita, Chief Payments Officer at Payments Canada. “Membership is a necessary key that unlocks new ways to engage with Payments Canada as well as the pathway to apply for system participation. Seeing such a diverse range of payment service providers and credit unions step forward shows that Canada’s payment industry is actively preparing to catalyze the full economic benefits of modern payments.”
Set to launch in Q4 2026, the RTR is a critical new piece of national infrastructure that will empower Canadians to safely exchange instant, data-rich payments, 24/7/365. With its initial capabilities at launch, the RTR is expected to generate between $5.3 billion and $14.5 billion in cost savings over the next decade, driven by lower processing costs, reduced usage of cash and cheques and float reduction, the period where funds are temporarily unavailable to the recipient. Over the next decade, this translates to $16 billion in economic gains—a figure that could reach over $27 billion as new functionalities are introduced over time.
As the system evolves, tangible benefits will be unlocked across the economy—helping gig workers access earnings instantly, giving small businesses real-time access to funds, speeding up loan payouts and eliminating delays in supplier payments.

title: NatWest Accelerator Takes Female-Founder Initiative She Scales Nationwide
summary:
NatWest Accelerator is expanding its She Scales initiative across the UK after a pilot delivered 68 events and more than 1,800 attendances, with every surveyed participant saying they felt more confident or better equipped to build their business.
The nationwide initiative creates a connected experience for female founders bringing together inspiring events, peer networks, practical expertise and growth opportunities through NatWest’s Accelerator hubs and digital community. It’s designed to help female founders build the connections, confidence and opportunities needed to grow successful businesses.
Following a pilot phase, She Scales is now being rolled out across the Accelerator community under a shared national identity: Where female founders build their future.
Since March 2026, She Scales has delivered 68 events across 13 NatWest Accelerator hubs, generating more than 1,800 attendances. Feedback from 211 attendees across 10 hubs found that:
95.7% of surveyed attendees were satisfied or very satisfied
Every survey respondent said NatWest Accelerator She Scales left them more confident or better equipped as a female founder
She Scales combines monthly networking, co-working and practical learning with a digital community that gives founders year-round access to peers, experts and opportunities.
Sessions focus on the practical challenges of starting and scaling a business, including artificial intelligence, marketing and funding. They also connect participants with experienced entrepreneurs, potential collaborators and local NatWest Accelerator teams.
NatWest Accelerator developed She Scales in response to feedback from female founders, who consistently identified three priorities: a stronger sense of belonging, greater visibility for themselves and their businesses, and better access to opportunities that can support growth.
Alongside the events, the Female Founders Community in the NatWest Accelerator app has grown to more than 1,900 members in under six months, making it one of the platform’s fastest-growing communities. It provides a 24/7 space for founders and allies to connect, share opportunities and access support beyond local events.
The initiative builds on activity established in Edinburgh more than a year ago and has operated across participating hubs since March 2026. NatWest Accelerator plans to extend it further as new hubs open across the UK.
Built around three founder priorities
She Scales is structured around the three areas founders said would make the greatest difference:
Belonging through a trusted community of peers who understand the realities of building a business.
Visibility through role models, storytelling, networking and access to experienced entrepreneurs.
Opportunity through connections, expertise, partnerships and practical business support.
Strong demand across the UK
London recorded the greatest overall reach, with 436 attendances across 11 events.
Leeds attracted 232 attendances across three events—an average of 77 per session—and recorded an 82% attendance rate.
The findings indicate strong demand for dedicated support for female founders. Of the 211 attendees surveyed, 95.7% were satisfied or very satisfied, while every respondent said the events had left them feeling more confident or better equipped as a female founder.
Sharniya Ferdinand, Strategic Partnership Inclusion Lead, NatWest Accelerator said:
“Starting and growing a business can be isolating, and founders told us they wanted more than occasional networking. They wanted a trusted community where they could build practical skills, raise their profile and form connections that lead to real opportunities.
“She Scales was built around those needs. The response so far from more than 1,800 attendances to the rapid growth of the digital community shows the appetite for dedicated, year-round support. Taking the experience nationwide will give more women access to the confidence, visibility and connections they need to move their businesses forward.”
Darren Pirie, Head of NatWest Accelerator & Partnerships said:
“Women-led businesses are a powerful driver of innovation, job creation and economic growth. Through She Scales, we’re bringing founders together to share expertise, broaden their networks and access opportunities that can help them unlock their next stage of growth. By investing in founder communities, we’re helping create the conditions for more businesses to scale successfully and contribute to a stronger, more innovative UK economy. We’re incredibly proud to see the community expanding across the UK, and we’re excited about the role She Scales can play in helping even more women realise their ambitions and scale successful businesses.”
Founder story: Stacey Smith, founder, JAN
Former elite international athlete Stacey Smith attended She Scales in Newcastle shortly after being made redundant and while preparing to launch JAN, her activewear brand.
Through She Scales and the wider Accelerator community, Stacey became a hub member and received support to refine her business goals, product proposition and target audience. She was connected to grant support, potential brand collaborators and an opportunity to showcase JAN through a female empowerment catwalk. NatWest also introduced her to a Business Development Manager to support her banking needs as the company moved towards launch.
The initiative is intended to become the overarching She Scales movement for women founders, combining broad-based community support with targeted opportunities as businesses develop.
Stacey Smith, founder of JAN said: “Building JAN has been exciting, but there’s a lot to learn when you’re turning an idea into a business. The support I’ve had from the NatWest Accelerator and She Scales has given me practical guidance, valuable connections and the confidence to keep moving forward. Nickie at NatWest has been especially generous with her time, encouragement and connecting me with people who can help grow my business and support me as a new founder. Having people who believe in both me and the brand has made a real difference but also spending time with other start up founders has been incredibly valuable to me. I wouldn't have been able to make this much progress with my business without Nickie and the Natwest Accelerator support system.”
Founder story: Helen Evans, founder of Business Growth Support Services, Birmingham
Through She Scales Birmingham, Helen Evans used her wealth of sales and business growth experience to support female founders on their scaling journey. Her practical session helped attendees build confidence, overcome the fear of selling and develop the skills needed to have meaningful customer conversations. Helen’s willingness to share her expertise and champion other women in business embodies exactly what She Scales is all about: women supporting women to succeed.
Helen Evans, founder of Business Growth Support Services said: “I joined She Scales because I wanted to put my sales experience to work for other women building businesses, not just my own. Being part of the Birmingham community gave me the platform to deliver 'Turning Conversations into Sales' at the NatWest Accelerator to help early founders overcome some of preconceived ideas of what sales is and to bring some structure into those early conversations. It's been a brilliant way to connect with founders and grow Business Growth Support Services at the same time.” 
Founder story: Rosie Thurston, founder of EduCreate, Milton Keynes
Rosie Thurston founded EduCreate, an alternative learning provision for young people at risk of disengagement, suspension, or permanent exclusion, joined the Accelerator in 2018 and then took a break to raise two children with her wife before re-engaging through She Scales. Since reconnecting, Rosie has doubled down on a new income route via public funded procurement opportunities with NatWest’s direction, and also taken on a university of Cranfield intern which has been a fantastic addition to her growing team.
Rosie Thurston, founder of EduCreate in Milton Keynes said: “Being part of the NatWest She Scales programme has been incredibly valuable, both personally and for the growth of my business. Since joining the programme, I have tripled my turnover, and the tools, support and business mindset I have developed through NatWest have played a significant role in that growth. When I started the company, it was primarily me delivering workshops and tuition directly to schools. Through the one-to-one mentoring provided by She Scales, I’ve been able to step away from the day-to-day delivery and focus more strategically on growing the business. That shift has enabled me to take on staff, expand our reach and think much more ambitiously about what the company can achieve.
“One of the things I value most about She Scales is the community. Running a business can be incredibly isolating, particularly when you’re making decisions on your own, dealing with self-doubt or simply wishing you had someone to bounce ideas off. She Scales provides a regular, supportive space to share challenges, get advice, celebrate successes and be inspired by other women who are building brilliant businesses. For me, it has been about much more than business growth. It has given me confidence, perspective and a network of genuine cheerleaders around me, and that has made a huge difference to both me and the business.”

title: MEXC and Payward Signal Intent to Explore Broader Collaboration Ahead of TOKEN2049
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, October 5, 2026, MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, and Payward, the parent company of Kraken, are in discussions to explore a collaboration as both platforms look at how exchanges can better serve users across evolving global markets. The two companies will bring the conversation to TOKEN2049 Singapore, where MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi will join a panel on the MEXC Stage to discuss the next phase of trading platforms and share further perspectives on collaboration between exchanges.   The discussion comes as trading platforms respond to several shifts happening at the same time. Users are seeking broader access across crypto and traditional markets, AI is changing how investors research and interact with trading tools, and social trading is creating new ways to discover and participate in market opportunities. Against this backdrop, exchanges are increasingly looking beyond individual products toward how market access, infrastructure, liquidity and user experience can work together more effectively. As platforms evolve, exchange security and user asset protection will also remain an important part of the conversation.   As the exchange industry evolves, platforms are building different strengths across user experience, market access, infrastructure and trading capabilities. MEXC has focused on retail user experience, deep liquidity and perpetual trading across crypto and TradFi assets, while Payward brings global compliant financial infrastructure, professional trading capabilities and a strong U.S. market presence. These different strengths create room to explore where broader collaboration could add value for users.   “Users increasingly expect broader market access without more complexity,” said Vugar Usi Zade, CEO of MEXC. “The next stage of trading will require strong user experience, liquidity, infrastructure and market access to work more closely together. As exchanges continue to evolve, there is growing room to explore where collaboration across the industry can create more value for users.”   The TOKEN2049 panel will take place on October 7 from 12:30 to 13:00 at the MEXC Stage, and will explore the trends reshaping trading, how exchanges are preparing for changing user expectations, and where greater collaboration between platforms could create value. The conversation will also look at the convergence of crypto and TradFi, the growing role of AI in trading, and how global trading platforms may evolve as markets and infrastructure become more connected.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   source   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions.

title: Plume Accelerates Tokenization’s Role in Global Finance with nBND Vault
summary:
Plume, the Open Finance platform for institutional assets, today announces the launch of its new nBND vault. For the first time, allocators can access a tokenized vault backed by Fidelity Total Bond ETF (FBND) as its primary reserve asset.
The maturity of onchain capital markets requires access to diverse assets that are battle tested and managed by world class financial institutions. Through the vault, Plume is supporting the development of a robust fixed-income market, not simply providing another isolated yield opportunity.
"While the onchain fixed income market was originally concentrated in short-duration Treasuries and money market equivalents, these are the starting points, not the destination. Institutional allocators want duration, and active management, the same building blocks they use offchain," said Chris Yin, CEO and Co-Founder of Plume.
This year, the tokenized U.S. treasuries market grew from $12 billion in April 2026 to $15 billion in June, just two months later. This is only a fraction of the global fixed income market that represents over $100 trillion in assets. Should this entire market be tokenized, as expected and outlined by respected asset management executives, the growth opportunity is considerable.
Collaboration between crypto-native and traditional financial institutions is essential in nurturing this market, bridging the technical infrastructure of blockchain with the expertise, and institutional trust that traditional finance has built over decades.
Institutional appetite for proven, yield-bearing assets onchain is apparent and this vault ensures this next phase of development continues.
"As tokenized assets and on-chain applications become more integrated into mainstream market infrastructure, a collaborative ecosystem is essential to expanding investment access," said Cynthia Lo Bessette, Head of Digital Asset Management at Fidelity Investments. "We're excited to collaborate with Plume to bring financial products on-chain, providing a broader set of investors with access to greater programmability to build custom portfolios, alongside investment solutions that unlock new forms of collateral utility and access to capital."

title: Coinbase says it cut a 90-case AI support test from 1–2 weeks to 30–45 minutes
summary:

content: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase recently reported significant efficiency gains from an artificial intelligence support test. Commenting on the launch, Mariko Beising, VP Financial Services and Partnerships at TrueLayer, said: "SumUp is a brilliant example of how Pay by Bank powers faster, simpler money movement for consumers. By integrating directly with TrueLayer, SumUp delivers a convenient account top up experience, while laying the foundations for broader Pay by Bank adoption across Europe."
Felix Lamouroux, SVP Global Banking at SumUp, says: "As SumUp expands its consumer offering, we are focused on making everyday financial interactions as simple and intuitive as possible. Working with TrueLayer helps us build a more connected experience across multiple banks in the SumUp App and gives us a strong foundation for developing further services. "

title: Basware Completes Acquisition of Trustpair, Strengthening Financial Integrity from Invoice to Payment
summary:
Basware, the global leader in Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM), today announced the completion of its acquisition of Trustpair, a leading payment fraud prevention platform, following the agreement announced in August.
The acquisition extends Basware’s invoice lifecycle management capabilities all the way to the payment itself: an invoice can be authentic, accurate and properly approved, but the supplier bank account associated with it may be fraudulent. 
Trustpair will continue to operate independently, maintaining its existing platform, specialist focus, customer relationships, contracts, and support. The company will continue to support and expand integrations across ERP, treasury, procure-to-pay and payment platforms. Customers will continue to be able to deploy Trustpair across their existing finance environments, whether or not they use Basware. This open ecosystem strategy remains unchanged and central to Trustpair’s approach.
The First End-to-end Lifecycle Assurance from Invoice to Payment
The acquisition brings together complementary capabilities that connect invoice and payment assurance. Basware establishes validity of the invoice by helping finance teams determine whether an obligation is authentic, accurate, compliant, and approved. Trustpair extends that to payment assurance by validating whether the supplier is genuine, the bank account belongs to that supplier, and the payment is going to the intended destination.
Together, these capabilities deliver financial integrity: a connected view of the financial decision behind every payment, linking the invoice and payment in one governed lifecycle.
As payment fraud increasingly targets supplier identities and bank details rather than the invoice itself, finance teams must establish trust when supplier data first enters the business, maintain it as information changes, and validate it again before funds are released. The combination of Trustpair and Basware makes this possible.
Jason Kurtz, CEO at Basware, commented on the completed acquisition:
“Trustpair has built a distinct capability around one of the most important control challenges facing finance teams today. An invoice can be authentic and accurate, but the financial outcome is still wrong if the payment goes to the wrong account. By bringing Basware’s invoice lifecycle management capabilities together with Trustpair’s payment assurance, we can help customers make that complete financial decision with greater confidence. Since we announced the agreement, customers have told us this is the missing piece they have been waiting for, and that excitement has only grown as we get closer to bringing our capabilities together.”
Baptiste Collot, Co-founder and CEO at Trustpair, added on the acquisition:
“Since announcing our intent to join forces, the market signal has been overwhelmingly clear: finance leaders recognize you can no longer dissociate the invoice from payment assurance without exposing your business to severe fraud. As payment threats become more sophisticated with AI, fraud prevention must be an active, connected layer across the entire invoice and payment lifecycle. While maintaining our independence, system-agnostic approach, we will tap into Basware’s scale, resources, and deep data foundation to innovate faster and continue building on our nine-year legacy of specialist payment assurance.”
For Basware’s 6,500+ customers, the acquisition provides broader assurance across the invoice-to-payment lifecycle. Longer term, the companies see an opportunity to combine Basware’s invoice and supplier context, spanning 2.5 billion invoices and 20 million suppliers, with Trustpair’s fraud-specific intelligence to identify risk earlier, automate validation and give finance teams a more complete view of what a company owes, why it owes it, who should receive the payment, and where the money should go.

title: Justin Sun Prize’s New Round Honors Human–AI Collaboration on Erdős Problems
summary: Geneva, Switzerland — October 5, 2026 — The Office of Justin Sun today announced the newest recipients of the Justin Sun Prize: independent researcher Wouter van Doorn, mathematics Ph.D. student Quanyu Tang, and mathematics researcher Yanyang Li from Nanjing’s Southeast University, recognized for contributions spanning six Erdős problems. Wouter van Doorn is an independent number theorist who began researching mathematics as an undergraduate in 2010 and continued collaborating and publishing after leaving academia following his master’s degree. Quanyu Tang (汤泉宇) is a mathematics Ph.D. student at the University of Science and Technology of China whose research spans number theory, combinatorics and AI-assisted mathematical discovery. Erdős problems are mathematical questions posed or popularized by Hungarian mathematician Paul Erdős about numbers, patterns and other mathematical structures. Often simple to state but difficult to solve, they have helped shape research in number theory and combinatorics, with some remaining open for decades. The Erdős catalog, compiled and maintained by Thomas Bloom, a mathematician and Royal Society University Research Fellow at the University of Manchester, has more than 1200 problems.  Van Doorn and Tang worked with Yanyang Li, from Southeast University’s School of Mathematics in Nanjing, to solve Erdős Problem #650, determining exactly how many integers can always be matched to distinct multiples within a specified interval. Van Doorn also produced computer-checkable proofs in Lean, software for verifying mathematical reasoning, for #369, concerning consecutive integers with restricted prime factors; #457, about whether a short run of consecutive integers can collectively contain every prime in a given range; and #469, concerning whether the reciprocals of a special class of numbers expressible as sums of their divisors add to a finite total. Tang separately resolved #1044, establishing a sharp lower limit for boundary lengths of regions defined by polynomials, and contributed alongside Li to a wider team’s solution of #1196, bounding weighted sums over sets of integers in which no member divides another. Their work on #650 offers a concrete example of how human judgment and AI can complement each other. ChatGPT helped develop the proof strategy, while Aristotle, an AI system for mathematical reasoning, repaired a gap during Lean formalization. The researchers then simplified the argument and wrote the final proofs and exposition. “This experience taught me how public feedback can sharpen a research question, and how AI-assisted discovery can combine mathematical judgment, collaboration and rigorous verification,” Tang said. These are the program’s first confirmed awards, recognizing both mathematical discovery and the work needed to make proofs independently checkable. Information about the Justin Sun Prize, its problem catalog and recipient contributions is available through the program’s public GitHub repository. The prizes will be paid out in either USDT on TRON (TRC-20) or USDC on Ethereum (ERC-20) based on the recipient’s choice. For more information, please visit www.hejustinsun.com/prize.    About the Office of Justin Sun The Office of Justin Sun supports Justin Sun’s global business, philanthropic and public initiatives across technology, blockchain, artificial intelligence, scientific research, investment, art and space exploration.    Justin Sun is the Ambassador and former Permanent Representative of Grenada to the World Trade Organization and the Founder of TRON. TRON is the leading blockchain for the stablecoin revolution, processing over $13 trillion in volume since its inception. In the world’s emerging markets, people rely on USDT on TRON to access the global financial system.   A protégé of Alibaba founder Jack Ma, Sun has been recognized internationally for his work in the digital asset industry, including a Forbes cover profile in April 2025 and multiple appearances on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list. In August 2025, he flew aboard Blue Origin’s NS-34 mission, becoming the 712th person in history to travel to space. His broader interests span technology, investment, philanthropy, art, gaming, and space exploration.   Office of Justin Sun Contact: info@hejustinsun.com    About Justin Sun Prize  The Justin Sun Prize is an academic initiative established by Justin Sun to support advances in mathematics, formal verification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery. The prize is decentralized and built around the principle that mathematical work should be judged by the strength, rigor, and verifiability of the proof itself, not the prestige or reputation of those submitting it.   Justin Sun established the prize in his own name as a long-term commitment to return wealth created through mathematics and technology back to mathematics itself. Its legacy is intended to be defined by the body of work it recognizes and the laureates whose discoveries stand the test of time. The prize links clearly defined mathematical challenges to machine-verifiable proof. Its guiding principles are openness, public benefit and open-source access.   Visit https://www.hejustinsun.com/prize for more information.    Contact: thejustinsunprize@hejustinsun.com
content: The Office of Justin Sun has announced the first recipients of the Justin Sun Prize, honoring independent researcher Wouter van Doorn, Ph.D. student Quanyu Tang, and researcher Yanyang Li for solving six Erdős problems. The award highlights the integration of human mathematical judgment with AI-assisted discovery and formal verification using tools like ChatGPT, Aristotle, and Lean. Prizes are awarded in USDT on TRON or USDC on Ethereum.

The proposal, put forward by industry leaders including representatives from Deblock and Lyzi, aims to clarify the tax framework for digital asset conversions within the country. This move highlights ongoing efforts by crypto firms to work alongside regulators in establishing clear tax policies.
content_ta: பிரான்ஸ் நாட்டில் உள்ள சில cryptocurrency நிறுவனங்களின் உயர் அதிகாரிகள், நிலையான கிரிப்டோகரன்சியான stablecoin மற்றும் பிற டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களுக்கு இடையேயான வர்த்தகத்திற்கு நேரடி வரி விதிக்க வேண்டும் என்று அரசாியத்தை வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளனர். Deblock மற்றும் Lyzi உள்ளிட்ட நிறுவனங்களின் தலைவர்களால் இந்தproposal முன்வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை நாட்டின் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து பரிமாற்றங்களுக்கான வரி கட்டமைப்பை தெளிவுபடுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Relating to Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets
summary: WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking to provide notice of, and seek public comment regarding, its intent to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework comprised of fit-for-purpose rules concerning section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act and retail commodity transactions described thereunder
content: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking in Washington. The agency is seeking public comment to help establish a comprehensive regulatory framework. This initiative focuses on developing fit-for-purpose rules regarding retail commodity transactions and section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act, aiming to provide clearer oversight for the sector.
content_ta: வாஷிங்டனில் Commodity Futures Trading Commission அமைப்பு, முன்மொழியப்பட்ட விதி உருவாக்கத்திற்கான மேம்பட்ட அறிவிப்பை வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. ஒரு விரிவான ஒழுங்குமுறை கட்டமைப்பை உருவாக்க பொதுமக்களின் கருத்துக்களை இந்த அமைப்பு கோருகிறது. இந்த முயற்சியானது சில்லறை கமாடிட்டி பரிவர்த்தனைகள் மற்றும் Commodity Exchange Act-இன் பிரிவு 2(c)(2)(D) தொடர்பான பொருத்தமான விதிகளுக்கு முக்கியத்துவம் அளிக்கிறது.

title: DOJ won’t reopen Powell probe
summary: There’s “more work to do to understand” how the Federal Reserve’s renovation project became so expensive, Attorney General Todd Blanche told Bloomberg TV, but the Justice Department won’t reopen its related investigation into Jerome Powell.
content: Attorney General Todd Blanche stated that the Justice Department will not reopen its investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. While noting that there is still more work to do to understand the high costs of the Federal Reserve renovation project, the DOJ decided against pursuing the related probe further at this time.
content_ta: Federal Reserve-ன் Jerome Powell மீதான விசாரணையை மீண்டும் திறக்கப் போவதில்லை என்று Attorney General Todd Blanche தெரிவித்தார். Federal Reserve கட்டிடப் புதுப்பிப்புப் பணிகளின் அதிக செலவுகள் குறித்து மேலும் புரிந்து கொள்ள வேண்டியுள்ளது என அவர் குறிப்பிட்ட போதிலும், DOJ இந்த விசாரணையைத் தற்போது தொடர வேண்டாம் என்று முடிவு செய்துள்ளது.
